name: Mita Maruko
source:
"Um, hello? I'm Maruko Mita, the store clerk. I work at Svetlana's shop! She's seriously like a real magician... Every day is exciting!♪ Oh, and lately, those strange voices we used to hear at the store... have stopped. Hmm, maybe I should ask the manager about it!"

A clerk who works under [url=/c160627]Svetlana[/url] and affectionately calls her "manager." She's all bravado when promoting the store, but in reality, she's timid and yelps at every little noise. Her skittishness seems to stem from past trauma. I wonder what happened... Maybe [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] will meet her someday.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category7&ch=mita]official website[/url]]
